title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil cadet (Melbourne)
content_text: Citywide graduates page: graduate roles and entry level opportunities including Civil infrastructure (civil engineering graduates and cadets, asphalters and road workers). Apply by emailing apply@citywide.com.au with CV/resume and cover letter. Head office 294 Arden Street North Melbourne VIC 3051. Citywide builds and maintains civil infrastructure, roads, parks and open space for Victorian communities.
apply_instructions: Email apply@citywide.com.au with CV/resume and a cover letter setting out skills, experience, interests, ambitions and alignment to Values.
